title: Lead List
summary: Turn a one-sentence customer profile into companies, a decision-maker at each and a verified work email, with the bill for every paid call.
outcome: A CSV of companies, one title-matched decision-maker per company and their verified work email, with the funnel, skipped rows and a per-call receipt.
boundary: The Skill judges company fit from discovery data only and does not research need, timing or intent; it does not guarantee yield, guess or return personal emails, send outreach, write to a CRM or exceed the caller-approved ceiling.

catalog_tools.purpose: Discover up to 100 candidate companies for a natural-language profile in one call.
List people and their titles at a shortlisted company domain.
Fallback title-filtered people search, used once per company with count 1 only when the first people search is still refused after one retry.
Find the selected person's work email cheaply from a profile URL or name and domain.
Fallback work-email finder used once when the first finder returns no email.
Verify the deliverability of each work email found.

inputs: A one-sentence customer profile with business type, geography and size
The number of companies to work through and a total spend ceiling
Existing customer, competitor and suppressed domains, and any earlier list to skip
outputs: A CSV with company, domain, decision-maker, title, profile URL, work email and verification status
The funnel from companies discovered to emails verified
Skipped companies and people with the reason
A receipt with tool, provider, run id and settled cost for every paid call, and the total

cost.model: One company-discovery call, then per shortlisted company one people search (or its fallback when the provider refuses), up to two work-email lookups and one verification.
cost.notes: Inspect current prices before quoting. Three companies settled at $0.082900 in the 12 October 2026 verification run; the quote uses per-call maximums and is higher. A refused call is not charged, so the fallback people search replaces the first one rather than adding to it.

approvals: Approve the plan and total ceiling once before the first paid call
Ask again before any step that would exceed the approved ceiling
No outreach or CRM write without explicit scope
compatibility: One authorized Scrollport connection with discover, inspect, run and wallet
A local file for the CSV and receipt, so later runs can skip existing rows
